method: PARAPHRASED AND HASH-ANCHORED from Spanish Society of Medical Oncology (SEOM), GEMCAD and TTD, Clinical and Translational Oncology (doi 10.1007/s12094-025-03916-y) 'SEOM-GEMCAD-TTD clinical guidelines for biliary tract cancer (2025)' (published 30 May 2025). Every claim is a paraphrase backed by anchors (scripts/anchor.py): verify.py --source re-finds each anchored span in a fresh copy of the source, checks the claim's numbers against it and rejects copying. LICENCE: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (read at NCBI PMC efetch JATS <license> element for PMC12259768 (Europe PMC returned HTTP 503 on 2026-09-23)). The source's words are NOT reproduced here.

claims.claim: **Biliary tract cancer is rare (about 1% of cancers) and usually presents at 65–84 years.** Jaundice from biliary obstruction is the commonest symptom (less so in gallbladder cancer); weight loss, poor appetite or abdominal pain suggest advanced disease.
claims.locator: Spanish Society of Medical Oncology (SEOM), GEMCAD and TTD, Clinical and Translational Oncology (doi 10.1007/s12094-025-03916-y), 'SEOM-GEMCAD-TTD clinical guidelines for biliary tract cancer (2025)', published 30 May 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12259768/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Risk factors** include chronic biliary inflammation, primary sclerosing cholangitis, liver flukes and hepatolithiasis (Asia), cirrhosis, hepatitis B and C, fatty liver disease, smoking and alcohol; gallstones and porcelain gallbladder predispose to gallbladder cancer.
claims.locator: Spanish Society of Medical Oncology (SEOM), GEMCAD and TTD, Clinical and Translational Oncology (doi 10.1007/s12094-025-03916-y), 'SEOM-GEMCAD-TTD clinical guidelines for biliary tract cancer (2025)', published 30 May 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12259768/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **CT of chest, abdomen and pelvis for nodal and distant spread; MRI for local extent of perihilar and distal tumours and for liver metastases.** FDG-PET is not for primary diagnosis. Stage by UICC 8th edition, per subtype.
claims.locator: Spanish Society of Medical Oncology (SEOM), GEMCAD and TTD, Clinical and Translational Oncology (doi 10.1007/s12094-025-03916-y), 'SEOM-GEMCAD-TTD clinical guidelines for biliary tract cancer (2025)', published 30 May 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12259768/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Check liver function and look for underlying liver disease** (HBV, HCV, fatty liver risk, sclerosing cholangitis, PBC). CA 19.9 is non-specific but useful for prognosis and response. ERCP or PTC can relieve obstruction.
claims.locator: Spanish Society of Medical Oncology (SEOM), GEMCAD and TTD, Clinical and Translational Oncology (doi 10.1007/s12094-025-03916-y), 'SEOM-GEMCAD-TTD clinical guidelines for biliary tract cancer (2025)', published 30 May 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12259768/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Tissue (core biopsy where possible) is mandatory before systemic therapy,** for histology and NGS. A biopsy is not always needed before curative resection.
claims.locator: Spanish Society of Medical Oncology (SEOM), GEMCAD and TTD, Clinical and Translational Oncology (doi 10.1007/s12094-025-03916-y), 'SEOM-GEMCAD-TTD clinical guidelines for biliary tract cancer (2025)', published 30 May 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12259768/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Do comprehensive NGS early, especially in advanced disease,** for IDH1/2, FGFR2 fusions, KRAS, BRAF V600E and NTRK, plus HER2 immunohistochemistry and MSI. Around 45% have a potentially targetable alteration; FGFR2 fusions and IDH1 mutations cluster in intrahepatic tumours.
claims.locator: Spanish Society of Medical Oncology (SEOM), GEMCAD and TTD, Clinical and Translational Oncology (doi 10.1007/s12094-025-03916-y), 'SEOM-GEMCAD-TTD clinical guidelines for biliary tract cancer (2025)', published 30 May 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12259768/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Resection with clear margins is the only cure, but only 20–30% are candidates;** a specialised multidisciplinary team should decide on surgery and all treatment.
claims.locator: Spanish Society of Medical Oncology (SEOM), GEMCAD and TTD, Clinical and Translational Oncology (doi 10.1007/s12094-025-03916-y), 'SEOM-GEMCAD-TTD clinical guidelines for biliary tract cancer (2025)', published 30 May 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12259768/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **After resection, offer eight cycles of adjuvant capecitabine** (BILCAP). Radiotherapy afterwards is an exception for R1-resected gallbladder or extrahepatic tumours. Neoadjuvant treatment remains experimental.
claims.locator: Spanish Society of Medical Oncology (SEOM), GEMCAD and TTD, Clinical and Translational Oncology (doi 10.1007/s12094-025-03916-y), 'SEOM-GEMCAD-TTD clinical guidelines for biliary tract cancer (2025)', published 30 May 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12259768/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Locally advanced disease: systemic therapy first,** with locoregional options (ablation, radiotherapy, intra-arterial therapy) for selected patients; reassess for surgery after a response. Node-negative unresectable hilar tumours may suit liver transplantation in a specialised centre.
claims.locator: Spanish Society of Medical Oncology (SEOM), GEMCAD and TTD, Clinical and Translational Oncology (doi 10.1007/s12094-025-03916-y), 'SEOM-GEMCAD-TTD clinical guidelines for biliary tract cancer (2025)', published 30 May 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12259768/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Standard first line for unresectable or metastatic disease is cisplatin–gemcitabine plus a checkpoint inhibitor** (durvalumab or pembrolizumab), regardless of PD-L1 or targetable alterations. If immunotherapy is contraindicated, cisplatin–gemcitabine alone; if cisplatin is contraindicated, gemcitabine alone or with oxaliplatin.
claims.locator: Spanish Society of Medical Oncology (SEOM), GEMCAD and TTD, Clinical and Translational Oncology (doi 10.1007/s12094-025-03916-y), 'SEOM-GEMCAD-TTD clinical guidelines for biliary tract cancer (2025)', published 30 May 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12259768/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Durvalumab added to cisplatin–gemcitabine raised 36-month survival from 6.9% to 14.6%,** and was the only one of the two immunotherapy trials to also improve progression-free survival and response.
claims.locator: Spanish Society of Medical Oncology (SEOM), GEMCAD and TTD, Clinical and Translational Oncology (doi 10.1007/s12094-025-03916-y), 'SEOM-GEMCAD-TTD clinical guidelines for biliary tract cancer (2025)', published 30 May 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12259768/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Second line without a target: FOLFOX** (about 45% are fit for it). Single fluoropyrimidine or irinotecan suits those who cannot take a doublet; FOLFIRI only in highly selected cases. Liposomal irinotecan is not recommended outside trials.
claims.locator: Spanish Society of Medical Oncology (SEOM), GEMCAD and TTD, Clinical and Translational Oncology (doi 10.1007/s12094-025-03916-y), 'SEOM-GEMCAD-TTD clinical guidelines for biliary tract cancer (2025)', published 30 May 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12259768/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **IDH1-mutant cholangiocarcinoma after at least 1 prior line: ivosidenib** (ClarIDHy: median PFS 2.7 vs 1.4 months). IDH1 mutations occur in 10–20% of intrahepatic tumours.
claims.locator: Spanish Society of Medical Oncology (SEOM), GEMCAD and TTD, Clinical and Translational Oncology (doi 10.1007/s12094-025-03916-y), 'SEOM-GEMCAD-TTD clinical guidelines for biliary tract cancer (2025)', published 30 May 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12259768/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **FGFR2 fusion after at least 1 prior line: an FGFR inhibitor (futibatinib or pemigatinib).** Monitor for hyperphosphataemia, nail changes and retinal toxicity.
claims.locator: Spanish Society of Medical Oncology (SEOM), GEMCAD and TTD, Clinical and Translational Oncology (doi 10.1007/s12094-025-03916-y), 'SEOM-GEMCAD-TTD clinical guidelines for biliary tract cancer (2025)', published 30 May 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12259768/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Other targets after progression:** dabrafenib–trametinib for BRAF V600E; pembrolizumab for MSI-high/dMMR or high TMB; NTRK inhibitors; HER2-directed drugs for HER2-positive disease; selpercatinib for RET fusions. Re-check the NGS panel over time.
claims.locator: Spanish Society of Medical Oncology (SEOM), GEMCAD and TTD, Clinical and Translational Oncology (doi 10.1007/s12094-025-03916-y), 'SEOM-GEMCAD-TTD clinical guidelines for biliary tract cancer (2025)', published 30 May 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12259768/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **After curative treatment, review every three to six months for two years** (examination, bloods, CEA and CA 19–9, CT chest, abdomen and pelvis), then yearly to five years; on systemic therapy, CT every three months.
claims.locator: Spanish Society of Medical Oncology (SEOM), GEMCAD and TTD, Clinical and Translational Oncology (doi 10.1007/s12094-025-03916-y), 'SEOM-GEMCAD-TTD clinical guidelines for biliary tract cancer (2025)', published 30 May 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12259768/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **After surgery, watch for malabsorption and diarrhoea from pancreatic insufficiency,** which may need chronic treatment. Biliary obstruction needs specialist multidisciplinary decisions on drainage.
claims.locator: Spanish Society of Medical Oncology (SEOM), GEMCAD and TTD, Clinical and Translational Oncology (doi 10.1007/s12094-025-03916-y), 'SEOM-GEMCAD-TTD clinical guidelines for biliary tract cancer (2025)', published 30 May 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12259768/, retrieved 2026-09-23
